topic.title: Breaking changes from 1.0
topic.p: This page lists API changes since 1.0-rc3 and explains how to update existing code.

topic.title: GuiControl
topic.p: SetFocus and GetFocus are renamed to SetFocused and GetFocused.

topic.title: GuiListControl
topic.p: Adding items could cause flashing during rendering for about 1 frame. To workaround this issue, call GuiControlHost::ForceCalculateSizeImmediately after finishing editing all items in a rendering cycle, in either C++ or Workflow. A control host is a top level window like window or menu. You could also call the same function in `ContainerComposition` of any list controls, but this function is only available to C++.

topic.title: GuiControlHost
topic.p: WindowReadyToClose event is added. WindowClosing is called first, and if it does not cancel the operation, WindowReadyToClose is close, then the window is close, then WindowClosed is called.

topic.title: GuiSinglelineTextBox and GuiMultilineTextBox
topic.p: GuiSinglelineTextBox inherits from GuiDocumentLabel.
GuiMultilineTextBox inherits from GuiDocumentViewer.
Use SetCaret instead of Select. Use EditMode instead of Readonly.

topic.title: GuiImageFrameElement
topic.p: GuiImageFrameElement will not check frame index availability anymore. The renderer should handle that properly.

topic.title: GuiColorizedTextElement
topic.p: GuiColorizedTextElement is removed.

topic.title: GuiGraphicsComposition
topic.p:
Removed:
Margin property
IsTrivialComposition function
PreferredBounds property
Renamed:
ClientArea property to CachedClientArea property
MinPreferredMinSize property to CachedMinSize and CachedMinClientSize property
Bounds and PreviousCalculatedBounds property to CachedBounds property
FindComposition function to FindVisibleComposition function.

topic.title: GuiGraphicsEventReceiver
topic.p:
The nine button-specific events are removed and replaced by three GuiMouseEvent members:
leftButtonDown, middleButtonDown, and rightButtonDown are replaced by mouseDown.
leftButtonUp, middleButtonUp, and rightButtonUp are replaced by mouseUp.
leftButtonDoubleClick, middleButtonDoubleClick, and rightButtonDoubleClick are replaced by mouseDoubleClick.
These names also change on reflected GuiGraphicsComposition objects, including event bindings in GacUI Resource XML.

GuiMouseEventArgs::button is added with type NativeMouseButton and default value NativeMouseButton::Left. For the three new events, it identifies the button that caused the event: Left, Middle, Right, Mouse4, or Mouse5. The inherited left, middle, and right fields still describe held-button states. Use button to distinguish the event's button, including on release.

A double click raises mouseDown, mouseUp, mouseDown, mouseDoubleClick, then mouseUp. GuiItemMouseEventArgs and GuiNodeMouseEventArgs inherit button. The existing button-specific Item events on GuiListControl and Node events on GuiVirtualTreeListControl are kept. Handle Mouse4 and Mouse5 through composition events.

topic.title: IGuiShortcutKeyManager and GuiShortcutKeyItem
topic.p: GuiShortcutKeyManager::CreateShortcutInternal, the GuiShortcutKeyItem constructor, and GuiShortcutKeyItem::CanActivate taking separate modifiers also add this parameter before the key. GuiShortcutKeyItem::ReadKeyConfig adds an output parameter bool& _osSuper between _alt and _key. Shortcut matching includes the Super modifier, so a shortcut without it does not match a Super chord.

topic.title: GuiToolstripCommand::ShortcutBuilder
topic.p: Add bool osSuper = false. The SHORTCUT parser accepts Win, Command, and Super as names for the same modifier on every platform. For example, Ctrl+Command+Q and Ctrl+Win+Q specify the same shortcut. GuiShortcutKeyItem::GetName() uses the platform label returned by INativeResourceService::GetOSSuperKeyName().

topic.title: GuiGraphicsSite
topic.p: This class is removed, members are merged to its base class GuiGraphicsComposition.

topic.title: GuiBoundsComposition
topic.p: Bounds property is renamed to ExpectedBounds.
AlignmentToParent property will no longer consider parent's InternalMargin property in layout.

topic.title: GuiTableComposition
topic.p: Removed GetCellArea and UpdateCellBounds functions.
When MinSizeLimitation is not LimitToElementAndChildren, layout of cells is not considered in the table's minimum size.

topic.title: ThemeName
topic.p: New theme SystemFrameWindow for control template of GuiWindow when the system frame is enabled.
New theme CustomFrameWindow for control template of GuiWindow when the system frame is disabled.
New theme RibbonGroupMenu for control template of a drop down menu when GuiRibbonGroup is collapsed to a button.

topic.title: ThemeTemplates
topic.p: New themes as described in ThemeName.

New property PreferCustomFrameWindow. The default value is nullptr. At least one ThemeTemplates should have this property set to non-null. The latest ThemeTemplates with a non-null PreferCustomFrameWindow decides whether to use SystemFrameWindow or CustomFrameWindow when a window's theme name is ThemeName::Window.

topic.title: DEFINE_GUI_GRAPHICS_ELEMENT
topic.p: This macro is removed.

topic.title: DEFINE_CACHED_RESOURCE_ALLOCATOR
topic.p: This macro is removed.

topic.title: DEFINE_GUI_GRAPHICS_RENDERER
topic.p: This macro is removed.

topic.title: IGuiGraphicsRenderTarget
topic.p: A parameter is added to PushClipper and PopClipper. The generator describes the object that creates the current clipper, it could be nullptr. The value of this parameter does not matter in almost all the cases, usually it is an element or a composition.
New methods IsInHostedRendering, StartHostedRendering and StopHostedRendering.
Use GuiGraphicsRenderTarget to implement IGuiGraphicsRenderTarget to reduce complexity, without bothering with dealing with hosted or non-hosted mode, and some calculation of clippings.

topic.title: IGuiGraphicsParagraph
topic.p: OpenCaret and CloseCaret has been replaced by EnableCaret, DisableCaret and BlinkCaret.

EnableCaret and DisableCaret tells if the caret is activated in this specific paragraph or not. BlinkCaret switch the caret between visible and invisible, it should be ignored if the caret is disabled.

InlineObjectProperties::backgroundColor is added to the struct. This field tells an additional color on the object, when its alpha channel is zero it should be ignored. In the past, the background color is set by SetBackgroundColor. Now SetBackgroundColor as well as any other text attributes should be ignored when rendering inline objects. Currently this indicates if an object is selected or not. You can choose any way to render it.

topic.title: INativeWindow
topic.p: SetFocus and IsFocused is removed, because now activated means focused.
New method IsActivelyRefreshing, it always returns true for native platform provider.
New method GetRenderingOffset, it always returns {0,0} for native platform provider.
New method IsRenderingAsActivated, it should returns true when the window or any child window is activated.
New method SuggestMinClientSize, ignore it in native OS platform implementation.

topic.title: INativeWindowListener
topic.p: Update listener overrides and native platform dispatch to use these callbacks for all five buttons. Move button-specific behavior into a test or switch on button. For example, a call to LeftButtonDown(info) becomes MouseDown(NativeMouseButton::Left, info). On the second press of a double click, call MouseDown immediately before MouseDoubleClick.

MouseMoving, HorizontalWheel, and VerticalWheel still take only const NativeWindowMouseInfo& info. All mouse callbacks receive the Super modifier in info.osSuper. Capture this state with the native event and pass it to the listener.
New callback RenderingAsActivated and RenderingAsDeactivated, called when INativeWindow::IsRenderingAsActivated is changed.

Closing renamed to BeforeClosing and AfterClosing. BeforeClosing of all listeners must be called first, followed by AfterClosing of all listeners, if none of listeners cancel the closing in BeforeClosing.
New callback NeedRefresh, ForceRefresh and BecomeNonMainHostedWindow, they should not be called from a native platform provider.
A parameter is added to DpiChanged. DpiChanged(true) of all listeners must be called first, followed by DpiChanged(false) of all listeners.

topic.title: NativeMouseButton and input information
topic.p: Add enum class NativeMouseButton in vl::presentation, with values Left, Middle, Right, Mouse4, and Mouse5. It identifies the button passed to INativeWindowListener mouse-button callbacks and stored in GuiMouseEventArgs::button.

Add bool osSuper = false to WindowMouseInfo_<T>, NativeWindowKeyInfo, and NativeWindowCharInfo. It records Win on Windows, Command on macOS, or Super on Linux. In WindowMouseInfo_<T> it follows shift; in key and character information it follows alt. Update positional aggregate initializers for the inserted field.

topic.title: INativeInputService
INativeResourceService
topic.p: Add the pure virtual method WString GetOSSuperKeyName(). Implementations return Win on Windows, Command on macOS, and Super on Linux. This controls the modifier label displayed by GuiShortcutKeyItem::GetName().

topic.title: IGuiPlugin
topic.p: New parameters controllerUnrelatedPlugins and controllerRelatedPlugins is added to IGuiPlugin::Load and IGuiPlugin::Unload. In unit test GacUI will restart for many times, these parameters tell a plugin why it is loaded or unloaded, giving the plugin to skip some work if possible.

topic.title: GetCurrentController and SetCurrentController
topic.p: It is renamed to SetNativeController. GetCurrentController no longer returns the object in SetNativeController, instead it returns a new implementation of INativeController of which services could be substituted by GetNativeServiceSubstitution.

topic.title: New helper functions
topic.p: PerformHitTest to call INativeWindowListener::HitTest on a collection of listeners.
GetCursorFromHitTest to get a suggested cursors from hit test results.
(Try)?FindObjectByName and (Try)?FindControlByText to get an object with ref.Name specified in GacUI Resource XML from an object created in a <Instance/>.

topic.title: New macros
topic.p: GUI_DEFINE_KEYBOARD_WINDOWS_NAME for suggested names for keys.

topic.title: SharedAsyncService
topic.p: This class is offered as a default implementation of INativeAsyncService.

topic.title: SharedCallbackService
topic.p: This class is offered as a default implementation of INativeCallbackService and INativeCallbackInvoker.

topic.title: FakeDialogService
topic.p: This class is offered as a default implementation of INativeDialogService for hosted mode only. To use this service in hosted mode, INativeController::DialogService of a native platform provider could just return nullptr.
